source: Stuck at the signal near Andheri station, I'll be there in 15 minutes.
target: The signal near Andheri station holds me captive. I shall be there in fifteen minutes.

source: Sorry, my bus hasn't come yet. Don't order food until I get there.
target: Forgive me. My bus has not yet appeared. Order no food… until I arrive.

source: Can you tell Priya I'll be 20 minutes late to the class?
target: Will you inform Priya that I shall reach the class twenty minutes late?

source: My flight is delayed by two hours, so don't come to the airport yet.
target: My flight has been delayed by two hours. Do not come to the airport… not yet.

source: Running behind, I'll reach the restaurant around 8:15.
target: Time has slipped from my grasp. I shall reach the restaurant at around eight-fifteen.

source: If the train is late again, I'll take an auto from the station.
target: If the train fails me once more, I shall take an auto from the station.

source: Rahul, are you still waiting at the gate? I'm five minutes away.
target: Rahul, do you still await me at the gate? Only five minutes separate us.

source: The meeting started at 9 and I'm still parking the car.
target: The meeting began at nine… and still I struggle to park the car.

source: Please save me a seat, I'm going to be a little late.
target: Hold a seat for me. My arrival shall be slightly delayed.

source: I overslept and missed the 7:40 train. Will catch the next one.
target: Sleep held me too long… and the seven-forty train departed without me. I shall take the next one.

source: Don't wait for me at dinner tonight, I'm stuck at the clinic.
target: Do not wait for me at dinner tonight. The clinic still holds me.

source: Is it okay if I join the call 10 minutes after it starts?
target: Will you permit me to join the call ten minutes after it begins?

source: Tell Ananya I won't make it before lunch.
target: Inform Ananya that I shall not arrive before lunch.

source: Traffic on the flyover is terrible. I might miss the start of the movie.
target: Traffic chokes the flyover. Perhaps… I shall miss the start of the movie.

source: Sorry, Mark, the cab cancelled on me twice. Leaving now.
target: Forgive me, Mark. Twice the cab has abandoned me. I depart now.

source: I'll be late unless the rain stops in the next half hour.
target: My arrival shall be late… unless the rain relents within the next half hour.

source: Why is the delivery guy always late on Fridays?
target: Why does the delivery man forever arrive late on Fridays?

source: Could you push our call to 4:30? My last meeting is running over.
target: Move our call to four-thirty. My last meeting refuses to end.

source: Fatima is stuck in traffic, so we'll start the quiz without her.
target: Fatima remains trapped in traffic. We shall begin the quiz without her.

source: I'm not late yet, but I will be if this lift doesn't come soon.
target: Lateness has not yet claimed me… but it shall, if this lift does not come soon.

source: Leaving the house now. Should be there by quarter past six.
target: Now I leave the house. I should be there by a quarter past six.

source: Kenji texted that his train is 40 minutes late.
target: Kenji sends word: his train is forty minutes late.

source: Start the presentation if I'm not there by ten.
target: If I have not arrived by ten, begin the presentation.

source: Do you want me to grab coffee on the way, even though I'm late?
target: Late though I shall be, do you wish me to bring coffee on the way?

source: My scooter won't start, so I'll be late for the dentist.
target: My scooter refuses to wake. I shall be late for the dentist.

source: Can we order pizza tonight? I don't feel like cooking.
target: The will to cook has deserted me. Shall we order pizza tonight?

source: The biryani from last night is still in the fridge.
target: Last night's biryani endures… still within the fridge.

source: No onions in my sandwich, please.
target: My sandwich shall contain no onions. This I ask of you.

source: I've had three cups of coffee already and it's only noon.
target: Three cups of coffee have already been consumed… and it is only noon.

source: Meet me at the dosa place near the college at 1.
target: At one, you shall meet me at the dosa place near the college.

source: Is there any milk left for my tea?
target: Does any milk remain for my tea?

source: If you're going to the bakery, get me two croissants.
target: If your path leads to the bakery, bring me two croissants.

source: Lena cooked pasta for everyone, but I'm not hungry.
target: Lena has prepared pasta for all. Yet hunger does not stir in me.

source: The chai here costs 40 rupees, which is a bit much.
target: This chai demands forty rupees. A price… somewhat too high.

source: Can you share your lunch? I forgot mine at home.
target: My own lunch was left behind at home. Will you share yours with me?

source: We're out of rice, so dinner will be rotis tonight.
target: Rice has run out. Tonight… rotis shall serve as dinner.

source: I think the paneer has gone bad. Don't eat it.
target: I believe the paneer has spoiled. Do not eat it.

source: Let's try the new Thai place on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, let us seek out the new Thai place.

source: Who finished all the mangoes without telling me?
target: Who has consumed every mango… and told me nothing?

source: I'm craving ice cream but I'm trying not to eat sugar this month.
target: Ice cream calls to me. Yet this month, I strive to refuse all sugar.

source: Please heat the soup for two minutes before you serve it.
target: Before it is served, the soup must be warmed for two minutes.

source: Arjun only drinks black coffee, no milk or sugar.
target: Arjun drinks black coffee alone. No milk. No sugar.

source: Dinner's ready! Come down before it gets cold.
target: Dinner awaits. Descend now… before it grows cold.

source: Should I order samosas for the 12 people coming?
target: Shall I order samosas for the twelve who are coming?

source: This curry is way too spicy for me.
target: This curry burns beyond what I can endure.

source: We didn't get the extra cheese we paid for.
target: We paid for extra cheese. It never reached us.

source: Unless you're starving, let's wait for Grace before eating.
target: Unless hunger torments you, let us await Grace before we eat.

source: Grab 1 kg of tomatoes from the vegetable stall, would you?
target: Acquire one kilogram of tomatoes from the vegetable stall. Will you do this?

source: Breakfast was just toast today, no time for anything else.
target: Today's breakfast was toast alone. Time permitted nothing more.

source: The pani puri stall near the park closes at 9.
target: At nine, the pani puri stall near the park shuts its doors.

source: I've got a bad cold, so I'm skipping the gym today.
target: A heavy cold has seized me. Today, the gym shall go unvisited.

source: I barely slept last night, maybe three hours.
target: Sleep barely came last night… three hours, perhaps.

source: My head hurts. Can you turn the music down?
target: Pain has settled in my head. Will you lower the music?

source: I'm too tired to go out tonight, sorry Zoya.
target: Forgive me, Zoya. Weariness forbids me from going out tonight.

source: If my fever doesn't go down by tomorrow, I'll see a doctor.
target: If the fever does not retreat by tomorrow, I shall see a doctor.

source: Can't keep my eyes open. Going to bed early.
target: My eyes will not stay open. I retire to bed early.

source: Mom has a sore throat, so please don't make cold drinks.
target: Mom's throat is sore. Make no cold drinks… I ask this of you.

source: I took a nap at 3 and woke up at 6.
target: I surrendered to a nap at three, and rose again at six.

source: Did you take your medicine after lunch?
target: Has your medicine been taken after lunch?

source: I feel dizzy whenever I stand up too fast.
target: Dizziness claims me whenever I rise too swiftly.

source: Vikram is sick and won't be coming to football on Sunday.
target: Sickness has claimed Vikram. He shall not come to football on Sunday.

source: I'm sleepy but I still have two chapters to read.
target: Sleep beckons. Yet two chapters still await my reading.

source: Please wake me up at 6:30 if I don't hear the alarm.
target: If I do not hear the alarm, rouse me at six-thirty.

source: My back has been aching since Tuesday.
target: Since Tuesday, my back has endured a steady ache.

source: Is the pharmacy downstairs open after 10?
target: Does the pharmacy downstairs remain open past ten?

source: I don't think I can work today, my stomach is upset.
target: I do not believe I can labor today. My stomach is in turmoil.

source: Lucas has been coughing all night. Should we call the doctor?
target: Lucas has coughed through the whole night. Shall we summon the doctor?

source: Just woke up, give me ten minutes to get ready.
target: Only now have I awoken. Grant me ten minutes to prepare.

source: I need a long nap before the party.
target: Before the party, I require… a long nap.

source: Stop worrying, I'm feeling much better than yesterday.
target: Cease your worry. My body feels far better than it did yesterday.

source: Sneha wants the review shifted to Thursday. Is that fine?
target: Sneha seeks to shift the review to Thursday. Is this acceptable?

source: My manager wants the slides by 5 today.
target: My manager demands the slides… by five today.

source: I'm on leave next Monday, so please don't book any calls.
target: Next Monday I shall be on leave. Book no calls… none at all.

source: The client hasn't signed off on the design yet.
target: Approval of the design has not yet come from the client.

source: Who's presenting first at the 11 o'clock meeting?
target: Who shall present first at the eleven o'clock meeting?

source: Please mute yourself when you're not speaking.
target: When you are not speaking… mute yourself.

source: If Omar approves the budget, we can hire two interns.
target: If Omar gives his approval to the budget, we may hire two interns.

source: I've sent the report twice and still no reply from HR.
target: Twice I have sent the report. HR remains silent.

source: Our standup is cancelled today because half the team is out.
target: Today's standup is cancelled, for half the team is absent.

source: Could you review my pull request before lunch?
target: Before lunch, will you review my pull request?

source: I can't join the 2 pm call, I have a doctor's appointment.
target: I cannot join the call at two in the afternoon. A doctor's appointment claims that hour.

source: The deadline got pushed to the 20th, thank goodness.
target: Relief is mine… the deadline has been moved to the twentieth.

source: Don't reply-all to that email, just message me directly.
target: Do not reply to all on that email. Send your message to me alone.

source: Is the meeting room on the third floor free at noon?
target: Does the meeting room on the third floor stand empty at noon?

source: Ishaan is new, so please show him how the system works.
target: Ishaan is new among us. Show him the workings of the system.

source: I'm working from home tomorrow unless the boss says otherwise.
target: Tomorrow I shall work from home… unless the boss decrees otherwise.

source: Our floor's printer jammed again and ate my pages.
target: Once more, our floor's printer has jammed… and devoured my pages.

source: 40 tickets are still open and the sprint closes on Friday.
target: Forty tickets remain open. The sprint closes on Friday.

source: Can someone take notes? I'll be chairing the call.
target: I shall chair the call. Will someone record the notes?

source: My laptop died in the middle of the demo. So embarrassing.
target: My laptop perished in the middle of the demo. Such embarrassment.

source: The interview went okay, I guess, but I'm not sure.
target: The interview went acceptably, I suppose… yet I cannot be certain.

source: Please send me the invoice for 15,000 rupees by Wednesday.
target: By Wednesday, send me the invoice for fifteen thousand rupees.

source: Nobody showed up to the training session at 4.
target: No one came to the training session at four.

source: When the new hire joins, give her a desk near the window.
target: When the new hire arrives, grant her a desk near the window.

source: Why does every meeting with sales run over by half an hour?
target: Why must every meeting with sales overrun by half an hour?

source: Promise I'll send the draft to Meghna tonight.
target: This I promise: the draft shall reach Meghna tonight.

source: Ask Chen if he can cover my shift on Saturday.
target: Seek word from Chen… can he cover my shift on Saturday?

source: The office Wi-Fi won't work until IT fixes the router.
target: The office Wi-Fi shall not function until IT mends the router.

source: Let's not schedule anything after 6, people want to go home.
target: Let us schedule nothing after six. The people wish to go home.

source: Can you approve my leave for the 3rd and 4th of next month?
target: Will you approve my leave for the third and fourth of next month?

source: Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
target: Whose duty is it to carry out the trash?

source: Please water the plants while I'm away for the weekend.
target: In my absence this weekend… water the plants.

source: The dryer is rattling like crazy again.
target: Once more, the dryer rattles with wild abandon.

source: Kabir, stop throwing your socks under the sofa.
target: Kabir. Cease hurling your socks beneath the sofa.

source: I vacuumed the living room, but the kitchen is still dirty.
target: Vacuumed is the living room. Yet the kitchen… remains unclean.

source: Can you fold the laundry if you get home before me?
target: If you return home before me, will you fold the laundry?

source: The bathroom tap won't stop dripping since Sunday.
target: Since Sunday, the bathroom tap has not ceased its dripping.

source: We need to call the plumber before the guests arrive on Friday.
target: Before the guests arrive on Friday, the plumber must be summoned.

source: I spent 3 hours cleaning the garage today.
target: Three hours of this day were given to cleaning the garage.

source: Hand wash the cast iron pan, it can't go in the dishwasher.
target: Wash the cast iron pan by hand. It cannot enter the dishwasher.

source: Has the dog been walked yet, or should I take him?
target: Has the dog yet been walked… or shall I take him?

source: Sweep the balcony when the dust storm is over.
target: When the dust storm has passed… sweep the balcony.

source: Nisha said she'll do the dishes tonight, not me.
target: Nisha has declared that the dishes are hers tonight. Not mine.

source: The bathroom bulb went out, and we don't have a spare.
target: Darkness has taken the bathroom bulb. No spare remains to us.

source: Could you iron my shirt? I have an interview at 10.
target: An interview awaits me at ten. Will you iron my shirt?

source: Let's throw out the expired stuff in the fridge.
target: Let us cast out the expired things that dwell in the fridge.

source: If the maid doesn't come tomorrow, we'll split the cleaning.
target: If the maid does not come tomorrow, the cleaning shall be divided between us.

source: I've changed the bedsheets, so don't sit on them with shoes.
target: The bedsheets have been changed. Do not sit upon them with shoes.

source: The gas cylinder is almost empty. Book a refill?
target: Our gas cylinder nears its end. Shall a refill be booked?

source: Tidy your room, Emma, before Grandma comes.
target: Emma… your room must be tidied before Grandma comes.

source: Why are there dishes in the sink again?
target: Why do dishes lie in the sink once more?

source: The ceiling fan in the bedroom is wobbling badly.
target: In the bedroom, the ceiling fan trembles badly.

source: Mop the floor only after the paint dries.
target: Only when the paint has dried… may the floor be mopped.

source: Recycling goes out at 8 tomorrow, I'll handle it.
target: Tomorrow at eight, the recycling goes out. I shall see to it.

source: Please close the windows, the mosquitoes are coming in.
target: Close the windows. The mosquitoes force their way in.

source: It's pouring outside, take an umbrella.
target: Rain pours down in fury outside. Take an umbrella.

source: It's 42 degrees today, I'm not stepping out.
target: Forty-two degrees burn this day. I shall not step outside.

source: Will it rain during the match on Sunday?
target: Shall rain fall during the match on Sunday?

source: The fog is so thick I can't see the road.
target: So thick is the fog that I cannot see the road.

source: If it's sunny tomorrow, let's dry the carpets on the terrace.
target: If the sun shows itself tomorrow, let us dry the carpets on the terrace.

source: It's freezing in Delhi this week. Pack a jacket.
target: Delhi lies in the grip of cold this week. Pack a jacket.

source: The storm knocked out our power around midnight.
target: Around midnight, the storm struck down our power.

source: I don't think it'll snow before Christmas.
target: I do not believe the snow shall come… before Christmas.

source: Is it too windy to fly the kite?
target: Does the wind blow too fiercely for the kite to fly?

source: It hasn't rained in Chennai for three weeks.
target: Three weeks have passed… and no rain has fallen in Chennai.

source: The humidity is unbearable, my clothes never dry.
target: This humidity cannot be endured. My clothes never dry.

source: Wear sunscreen, the UV index is 9 today.
target: Wear sunscreen. Today the UV index stands at nine.

source: Hailstones dented the car roof last night.
target: Last night, hailstones struck and dented the roof of the car.

source: Bring the clothes in, it's going to rain any minute.
target: Bring in the clothes. Rain shall fall… at any moment.

source: The monsoon is late this year, the farmers are worried.
target: This year the monsoon delays its coming. The farmers… grow uneasy.

source: Would you fetch my passport photos from the studio near the temple?
target: Will you retrieve my passport photos from the studio that stands near the temple?

source: The shoes were 2,500 rupees, but I got them on sale.
target: The shoes were priced at two thousand five hundred rupees… yet I acquired them on sale.

source: We need eggs, bread, and dish soap from the store.
target: Eggs, bread and dish soap must be fetched from the store.

source: Don't buy the big pack, we won't finish it.
target: Buy not the big pack. We shall not finish it.

source: I have to go to the bank before it closes at 4.
target: Before the bank closes at four, I must go there.

source: Riya, did you return the library books yet?
target: Riya, have the library books been returned?

source: This jacket is too tight. Can I swap it for a large?
target: This jacket grips too tightly. May I exchange it for a large?

source: The pharmacy queue is huge, I'll be another 20 minutes.
target: Long stretches the pharmacy queue. I shall need… another twenty minutes.

source: Please get the receipt this time.
target: This time… secure the receipt.

source: Groceries came to 1,850 rupees this week.
target: This week, the groceries demanded one thousand eight hundred and fifty rupees.

source: Does the supermarket on MG Road open early on Sundays?
target: On Sundays, does the supermarket on MG Road open its doors early?

source: I have to post this birthday card to Ammi by Thursday.
target: This birthday card must be sent to Ammi by Thursday.

source: Pay the electricity bill online, don't stand in the line.
target: Settle the electricity bill online. Do not stand in the line.

source: The tailor said my kurta will be ready on the 9th.
target: The tailor has declared that my kurta shall be ready on the ninth.

source: Should I buy the blue sofa or the grey one?
target: Which shall I acquire… the blue sofa or the grey?

source: Hamid, could you drop off my suits at the dry cleaner?
target: Hamid, will you deliver my suits to the dry cleaner?

source: Hurry, the 50 percent discount on headphones is over tonight.
target: Make haste. The fifty percent discount on headphones ends tonight.

source: I couldn't find the right charger anywhere in the mall.
target: In all the mall, the right charger was nowhere to be found.

source: We'll get the new fridge when the old one finally dies.
target: When the old fridge breathes its last, we shall acquire the new one.

source: Remind me to renew my gym membership on Monday.
target: Remind me on Monday… my gym membership requires renewal.

source: My phone battery is at 5 percent, I might get cut off.
target: My phone's battery has dwindled to five percent. Perhaps I shall be cut off.

source: Our Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes, it's driving me mad.
target: Every few minutes, our Wi-Fi abandons us. It drives me to madness.

source: Can you send the photos on email? WhatsApp isn't working.
target: WhatsApp does not function. Will you send the photos by email?

source: The reset link for my email never arrives, I've tried five times.
target: Five times I have tried. The reset link for my email never arrives.

source: Don't update your phone yet, the new version has bugs.
target: Do not update your phone yet. The new version carries bugs.

source: Aditya, is your laptop charger the same as mine?
target: Aditya, does your laptop charger match my own?

source: My screen cracked when I dropped the phone on the stairs.
target: When the phone fell from my hand upon the stairs… its screen cracked.

source: If the call drops, I'll ring you back from the landline.
target: If the call falls silent, I shall call you back from the landline.

source: The TV remote isn't responding, maybe it needs new batteries.
target: No longer does the TV remote answer. Perhaps… it requires new batteries.

source: Please restart the router, the internet is down.
target: The internet has fallen. Restart the router.

source: I can't hear you, you're breaking up.
target: Your voice fractures. I cannot hear you.

source: My storage is full, so I can't download the app.
target: My storage is full. The app cannot be downloaded.

source: Somebody logged out of Netflix on the TV, who was it?
target: Netflix on the TV has been logged out. Who has done this?

source: The printer at home only prints in pink now.
target: Now the printer at home yields nothing but pink.

source: Text me when you reach, my calls aren't going through.
target: My calls do not pass through. When you reach… send me a text.

source: The app crashed twice while I was paying the bill.
target: Twice the app collapsed as I paid the bill.

source: Can you help me set up the new printer on Saturday?
target: On Saturday, will you aid me in setting up the new printer?

source: My earphones only work in one ear.
target: My earphones serve but one ear.

source: Don't share the OTP with anyone, even if they say they're from the bank.
target: Share the OTP with no one… even if they claim to be from the bank.

source: The video call keeps freezing, let's switch to audio.
target: The video call freezes again and again. Let us proceed with audio alone.

source: Are we still on for bowling at 7 on Friday?
target: Does our bowling at seven on Friday still stand?

source: Sam and Tara are coming over to watch the match.
target: Sam and Tara shall come here to watch the match.

source: Let's meet at the café near Koramangala at 5.
target: At five, let us gather at the café near Koramangala.

source: I can't make it to the trip, my exams start that week.
target: I cannot join the trip… my exams begin that very week.

source: If Neha's free, ask her to join us for dinner.
target: If Neha is free, summon her to join us for dinner.

source: Who's bringing the snacks for movie night?
target: Who shall bring the snacks for movie night?

source: We're splitting the bill four ways, so it's 600 each.
target: The bill shall be divided four ways. Six hundred… each.

source: Keep the surprise party a secret from Kiran, okay?
target: The surprise party must remain hidden from Kiran. Agreed?

source: Can we postpone the hike until the weekend after?
target: Shall the hike be postponed until the weekend after?

source: Javier booked the badminton court for 6 to 7 tomorrow.
target: Javier has secured the badminton court tomorrow, from six to seven.

source: I'm in for the concert, but I can't stay late.
target: I shall attend the concert… but I cannot stay late.

source: Please send me the location, I've never been there.
target: Send me the location. Never have I set foot there.

source: Let's not go to that bar again, it was way too loud.
target: Let us not return to that bar. Its noise was beyond endurance.

source: Divya's birthday dinner is on the 14th, don't forget.
target: Divya's birthday dinner falls on the fourteenth. Do not forget.

source: Is anyone up for a game of cricket this evening?
target: Who among you will join a game of cricket this evening?

source: We'll go to the beach unless it's too hot.
target: To the beach we shall go… unless the heat proves too great.

source: Haven't seen you in ages, let's catch up this weekend.
target: Ages have passed, and I have not seen you. This weekend, let us reunite.

source: Swing by and get me on your way to Aisha's place?
target: On your way to Aisha's place… will you come by for me?

source: Tom cancelled again, so it's just the three of us.
target: Tom has withdrawn once more. Only the three of us remain.

source: Let me know by Wednesday if you want a ticket.
target: Inform me by Wednesday… if you desire a ticket.

source: Dad wants everyone home by 9 for the puja.
target: Dad commands that all be home by nine for the puja.

source: Can you call Nani? She's been asking about you.
target: Nani has been asking after you. Will you call her?

source: My brother took my bike again without asking.
target: Once more, my brother has taken my bike… without asking.

source: Please don't fight with your sister in front of guests.
target: Do not quarrel with your sister before the guests.

source: Mom's flight lands at 10:45, who's picking her up?
target: Mom's flight lands at ten forty-five. Who shall collect her?

source: The kids have a holiday on Monday, so plan something fun.
target: Monday brings the kids a holiday. Plan something joyful.

source: Uncle Raj is staying with us until the wedding.
target: Uncle Raj shall remain with us until the wedding.

source: If Grandpa feels tired, we'll leave the party early.
target: If weariness finds Grandpa, we shall leave the party early.

source: My son scored 92 in maths and he's thrilled.
target: My son has scored ninety-two in maths. His joy is great.

source: Did you remember to call your mother on her birthday?
target: Did memory serve you? Was your mother called on her birthday?

source: Sara won't eat her vegetables unless we add cheese.
target: Sara shall not eat her vegetables… unless cheese is added.

source: We're visiting my in-laws in Pune for three days.
target: For three days, we shall dwell with my in-laws in Pune.

source: The baby is teething and cried all night.
target: Teething torments the baby. The cries lasted the whole night.

source: Ask your father before you take the car.
target: Before you take the car… seek your father's permission.

source: My parents' anniversary is next Saturday, let's order a cake.
target: Next Saturday marks my parents' anniversary. Let us order a cake.

source: Arnav, finish your homework before you turn on the TV.
target: Arnav. Your homework must be finished before the TV is turned on.

source: My sister doesn't want a big party this year.
target: My sister desires no grand party… this year.

source: Is Aunty Leela coming for lunch on Sunday?
target: Shall Aunty Leela come for lunch on Sunday?

source: Grandma fell asleep during the movie again.
target: Sleep claimed Grandma during the movie… once more.

source: Tell the kids dinner is in 15 minutes.
target: Inform the kids: dinner comes in fifteen minutes.

source: I'm so bored, there's nothing to do this afternoon.
target: Boredom has taken hold. This afternoon offers… nothing to do.

source: Just got the job offer, I can't stop smiling!
target: My job offer has come… I cannot cease smiling.

source: I'm nervous about my driving test on Thursday.
target: Unease grips me. My driving test comes on Thursday.

source: Honestly, the neighbor's drilling is driving me crazy.
target: In truth, the neighbor's drilling torments my mind.

source: Why is everyone so grumpy today?
target: Why does such ill temper possess everyone today?

source: I'm in a great mood, let's go out for dessert.
target: A fine mood has risen within me. Let us go out in search of dessert.

source: Don't talk to me until I've had my coffee.
target: Speak not to me… until my coffee has been taken.

source: I'm a bit anxious, Lily hasn't replied since morning.
target: A quiet anxiety stirs. Lily has not replied since morning.

source: I'm annoyed that the parcel came broken.
target: Irritation rises within me. The parcel arrived… broken.

source: If one more person asks about my wedding, I'll scream.
target: If one more soul asks about my wedding… I shall scream.

source: Feeling really happy today, the sun is finally out.
target: Joy has found me today. The sun has emerged at last.

source: I'm restless and can't focus on anything.
target: Restlessness reigns. I cannot fix my mind on anything.

source: Are you upset with me, Dev?
target: Dev… does anger toward me dwell in you?

source: I'm not mad at you, Pooja, just really tired.
target: Pooja, no anger toward you dwells in me. Only deep weariness.

source: So excited for the concert on the 22nd!
target: The concert on the twenty-second approaches. Excitement consumes me.

source: The metro is packed, I'll take the next one.
target: People overflow the metro. I shall take the next.

source: Our flight to Goa is at 6:20, so leave by 4.
target: Our flight to Goa departs at six-twenty. Leave by four.

source: Did you pack the chargers and the passports?
target: Have the chargers and the passports been packed?

source: The highway is closed, so the bus is taking a longer route.
target: With the highway closed, the bus takes a longer road.

source: Book an Uber if the auto drivers refuse to go.
target: If the auto drivers refuse the journey, summon an Uber.

source: I'll be in Mumbai from Tuesday to Friday.
target: From Tuesday until Friday, Mumbai shall hold me.

source: Can we stop for tea at the next dhaba?
target: Shall we halt for tea at the next dhaba?

source: The train to Jaipur doesn't have any seats left.
target: No seats remain on the train to Jaipur.

source: Please keep the tickets safe until we board.
target: Guard the tickets… until we board.

source: My suitcase didn't arrive with the rest of the luggage.
target: The rest of the luggage arrived. My suitcase did not.

source: How many hours is the drive to Lonavala from here?
target: How many hours does the road to Lonavala demand from here?

source: The toll on this road costs 120 rupees each way.
target: This road demands a toll of one hundred and twenty rupees… each way.

source: We missed the last ferry, so we're staying the night.
target: The last ferry has left without us. We shall remain for the night.

source: Nadia is driving, so I'll handle the music and directions.
target: Nadia shall drive. The music and directions fall to me.

source: Unless the road clears, we won't reach the hotel before dark.
target: Unless the road clears… we shall not reach the hotel before dark.
